race.comment: DR FARTHING (5) is poised to rebound from a below-par run in a CL3 at Eagle Farm. His two runs to kick-off the prep were much stronger and would take a race of this calibre out. Has been freshened with six weeks in-between and gets the blinkers on first time. Bold showing anticipated. CHANDON STAR (1) returns with an Ipswich trial win under his belt and is an 1000m specialist. Gets an important 2kg claim and is sure to give backers a bold sight from the favourable draw. Looks the biggest hurdle to the selection in a race that drops away quickly. SPEEDY ONE (4) will inject more pace into the race on the quick back-up and should be nearing his top third-up. Not dismissing.
